## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Dot R Interiors?
OMR Road, Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

### What facilities does Dot R Interiors have?
Interior design & build, Turnkey execution, Civil works, Electrical, HVAC & plumbing, MEP coordination, Custom furniture, Glass fabrication, Flooring, False ceilings, Corporate & IT offices, Retail & showrooms, Premium residences.

### Do you only do offices?
No. Dot R works across corporate offices, retail and showrooms, healthcare, hospitality and premium residences, including modular kitchens and wardrobes.

### What does turnkey cover?
Civil works, interiors, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, furniture, glass, flooring and false ceilings, managed by one team from design to handover.
